newsitem.title: UK: UK air force seeks tenders for 3 yr ad hoc air car.
newsitem.headline: UK air force seeks tenders for 3 yr ad hoc air car.

text.p: Britain's Royal Air Force Strike Command said it is seeking tenders for a three year contract to provide an ad hoc air cargo carrying capability.
The tenders are for up to 12 out-sized loads a year of military equipment exceeding the dimensions of a Lockheed C130 Hercules, the air force's standard transport aircraft.
There is also a tender for some 240 tonnes a year of general cargo both wheeled and suitable for consolidation on pallets, it said in a tender advertisement.
The out-size load contract will run from April 1, 1998 and the general cargo contract from October 1 this year, an air force spokeswoman added.
She declined to disclose the potential value of the contract.
The use of whole charter or incentive offers to use capacity on existing commercial flights will be considered, the tender call said.

It added that carriers may be expected to move equipment defined as "munitions of war" and they should be able to confirm they are able to handle such equipment and arrange thenecessary entry/overflight clearances.
Expressions of interest for all or part of the tenders are required by 18 July. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
